## CORE RULE 9. No EORG - Evac/Arrivals is a safe zone all round
"EORG", or "End-of-round Grief" is a common idea on some other servers, however we do not allow EORG on our server. Evac (both the shuttle and the hallway/lounge(s) leading to it) are considered protected areas and should not be intentionally damaged, left unfunctional, uninhabitable, or otherwise impeded/inaccessible.
Cryosleep and arrivals are off limits as outlined in [textlink="Roleplay Rule Three" link="RuleRSR3"].
There are exceptions to this, outlined in [textlink="Antagonist rules" link="RulePSS4"]. Extreme actions as part of a role (such as, causing a 'tesloose', 'singuloose', or arming and detonating the station nuke, for objectives like Die a Glorious Death or simply being a Nuclear Operative) are NOT violations of this rule. This does not extend to actions at Central Command. Once the shuttle itself launches, all objectives are final. ## CC is NOT to be EORGed on/in at any time, unless it has been explicitly [bold]Allowed[/bold] by an Administrator.
